algorithm.Title: Postpartum - Vision Loss or Change - Female (Child)
algorithm.ContentSet: IST Open-Source Guideline Content | Child | Female
Definition: Postpartum vision change assessment decomposed from NHS.UK's published pre-eclampsia guidance, distinct from the general Vision Loss or Change protocol (batch14).
FirstAid: Call Qatar emergency services on 999 now. Do not drive yourself. Tell the call handler that the patient gave birth recently. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.
algorithm.Author: IST Health Open-Source Guideline Content

questions.Question: Is vision loss or change the primary concern without recent childbirth?
questions.Information: Vision symptoms outside the postpartum period belong in the Vision Loss or Change pathway.

questions.Question: Is there a new postpartum vision change such as blurred vision, flashing lights, spots, or loss of vision, whether or not headache, upper abdominal pain, swelling, or vomiting is also present?
questions.Information: NHS.UK pre-eclampsia guidance lists vision problems as a key warning sign that can appear in the days or weeks after birth, needing immediate evaluation.

advice.Title: Emergency postpartum vision change precautions
Content: Call Qatar emergency services on 999 now. Do not drive yourself. Tell the call handler that the patient gave birth recently. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.
Call Back If: vision worsens; headache worsens.

references: NHS.UK, "Pre-eclampsia", https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/pre-eclampsia/ (page last reviewed 23 March 2026) - explicitly covers postpartum onset
